comments.text: A country with NO standing army, FREE education and healthcare for all, and consistently ranked the happiest in Africa... all while being a tiny island! 🤯 Looking at the Sega fire in image_05965a.png, you can really feel their vibrant spirit. It seems the world has a lot to learn from Mauritius. What do you guys think about a country having no military? 👇
